scope: Journey menu and tutorial environment illustrations. Existing faction and chapter identity art retained.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original wide hero illustration for the Journey menu of Gauntlet, a fantasy-industrial strategy card game.
Primary request: a beautifully painted expedition planning table inside an old commander archive, with an open unlettered parchment atlas, four small route markers of weathered copper, subdued violet stone, moss green stone, and steel blue stone, a brass compass, and an orderly stack of blank-backed playing cards. Behind the table, vaulted dark stone architecture recedes toward a softly lit doorway suggesting the beginning of a journey.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted game environment concept art, tactile traditional fantasy book illustration with restrained industrial craftsmanship; natural painterly detail, never photoreal or slick 3D.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2; visual focal group and warm light at the right two-thirds; left third is calm dark stone and desk shadow that will support live UI text. Keep all important objects inside central vertical 55% so it crops elegantly to a wide banner.
Lighting and color: warm amber lantern light across worn parchment and burnished brass, deep blue-black and forest charcoal shadows, subtle cool distant daylight. Rich material contrast without excessive bloom.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no buttons, no border. Four tiny colored route markers only, not four separate panels. This is actual environment art, not a screenshot or interface mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original landscape illustration for the learning route and tutorial of Gauntlet, a fantasy-industrial strategy card game.
Primary request: an intimate, inviting strategy-card practice table in a quiet stone chamber. On a worn dark green leather tabletop are a small, neat fan of ivory playing cards shown from their plain decorative backs, an aged brass hourglass, a few restrained amber counters, and a simple three-lane playing mat subtly embossed into the leather. One warm desk lantern lights the right side; bookshelves and a high narrow window fall gently out of focus behind.
Style: premium painterly fantasy game environment, rich handcrafted materials, delicate brush texture, realistic proportions, restrained industrial brass and dark iron details. Cohesive with an ancient expedition archive.
Composition: landscape 3:2, close three-quarter view from slightly above tabletop; objects grouped on the right half and upper middle, dark uncluttered left quarter and bottom quarter for separately rendered interface copy. Clean readable silhouettes, no clutter.
Palette and mood: welcoming, thoughtful, calm; amber and ivory highlights, deep blue-black stone, forest charcoal and dark green leather. The image should evoke learning and strategic possibility.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no buttons or frame. Cards have only subtle geometric backs with absolutely no faces, ranks, suits, or invented game rules. Create a finished environment illustration, not a UI mockup.
